0022600212.text: The 76ers (9-2, 1st in the East and in the Atlantic) host the Celtics (8-2, 2nd in the East and 0.5 games back in the Atlantic) in their 12th game of the season, with Philadelphia 4-1 at home and Boston 5-0 on the road... wait, Boston is 5-0 at home and 3-2 on the road. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 regular-season series 2-2, and the 76ers won 4-3 in the 2025-26 playoffs, including a 109-100 win in Boston on May 2, 2026. Philadelphia will be without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), while Adem Bona is day-to-day with a back sprain and is a game-time decision.
